key_insight: Self-evolving agents often improve overall performance, but their adaptation still trades off against retaining earlier capabilities.
engineering_relevance: For engineering assistants facing changing tools and workflows, prompt and memory updates require regression checks before they can support reliable continual adaptation.
method: Keep model weights frozen while adapting prompts, memory, or skills from task feedback.
Compare ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness across drifting task streams.
Assess adaptation gains alongside forgetting and interference.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on four streams built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld found aggregate gains on most streams, but consistently linked greater plasticity to reduced stability.
watch_item: The abstract reports no solid-mechanics validation; shared edits and conflicting memory retrieval remain deployment concerns.
